name: @playform/plugin-dsh-skill-learn
description: The skill-learn service: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that carries BOTH HALVES OF THE HERMES LEARNING LOOP as one service - the post-turn review that turns a finished session into skill edits, and the curator that ages the corpus. The review runs from the harness idle edge (`agent/status` with `status === "idle"`), claims the true idle phase through `agent.runMaintenance`, reads the transcript from `Agent.session.deriveMessages()`, reads the catalog through `ctx.skills.list` and `ctx.skills.get`, and makes exactly TWO hand-built `ctx.llm.stream` requests with a strict JSON reply: a plan call carrying the bounded digest and the skill index, and a confirm call carrying the exact bodies the plan asked to see, so a patch can only target text the model was handed. The write path is a FENCE: three operation kinds (create, patch, support), no delete and no archive in the reply schema at all, `createIfAbsent` refusing an existing path, `editText` behind a version guard refusing a missing or moved one, and sixteen deterministic judge rules running before any of it. The posture is AUTONOMOUS writes behind that fence (`policy.write: auto`, the Hermes parity decision), the curator's worst outcome is a move into `~/.dsh/skills/.archive/`, every mutation appends one ledger row with its before and after blobs so a revert restores exact bytes, and the plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/SKILL-LEARN-PLUGIN.md.
